data.name: Jami
data.gender_notes: Jami is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jami is derived from the Arabic word jamal which means beauty. The name Jami carries the meaning “Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jami usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jami is also the name of a Surah in the Quran which signifies the beauty and majesty of Allah.
data.etymology: Jami belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jami total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جامي
in_arabic.meaning: جامع، جمع کرنے والا، اکٹھا کرنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جامي من الجماعة و الجمع، و هو جامع للأشياء، أي يجمعها و يضمها، و قد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة، حيث يقول الله تعالى: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، الآية التي تشير إلى جامعية الله تعالى لجميع العوالم و الأشياء

in_urdu.name: جامی
in_urdu.meaning: جامع، جمع کرنے والا، اکٹھا کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جامی کا مطلب ہے جامع، جمع کرنے والا یا اکٹھا کرنے والا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'جَمَعَ' (جَمْع) فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اکٹھا کرنا یا جمع کرنا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی صفات میں سے ایک کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یعنی جامعیت

in_hindi.name: जामी
in_hindi.meaning: जميع, संग्रह करने वाला, इकट्ठा करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: जामी नाम का अर्थ है सभी को इकट्ठा करने वाला या संग्रह करने वाला। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'جَمَعَ' (जम'आ) क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है इकट्ठा करना या संग्रह करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की विशेषताओं में से एक को प्रकट करता है, अर्थात् उसकी सर्व-व्यापकता

in_pashto.name: جامي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د جامي نوم معنی دی جمع کوونکی یا ټولګی کوونکی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'جَمَعَ' (جَمْع) فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده ټولګی کول یا جمع کول. په اسلامي کلتور کې، دا نوم د اهميت وړ دی ځکه چې دا د الله تعالی یو له صفاتو څخه څرګندوي، یعنې د ټولو شیانو جامعیت

in_english.name: Jami
in_english.meaning: Collector, gatherer, one who brings together
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jami is derived from the Arabic root 'جَمَعَ' (j-m-ʿ), which means 'to gather, collect, or bring together'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies one who collects or gathers things, and it is associated with the attribute of Allah, al-Jami', who gathers and unites all things. The name Jami has been used in various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic theology and spirituality

pronunciation.urdu: جامی کا تلفظ ہے جاہ می
pronunciation.hindi: जामी का उच्चारण है जाह मी
pronunciation.pashto: د جامي تلفظ دی جاه مي

data.cultural_impact: The name Jami holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is often used as a suffix to denote a center or a place of gatherings, such as a Jami Masjid (Mosque) or a Jami Athar (School). Thus, the name symbolizes a sense of unity, gathering, and learning that is essential in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Jami holds a spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as it brings to mind the idea of the gathering of all souls before Allah on the Day of Judgment. The name is a reminder of the importance of striving towards spiritual beauty (Jamal Qalib) and inner transformation (Tazkiya), in accordance with the Islamic faith. It encourages individuals to seek knowledge and wisdom in order to fulfill their spiritual potential.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Beauty" symbolizes Jami is derived from the Arabic word jamal which means beauty.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jami serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of beauty.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ali ibn Abi Talib (600-661 CE) was the cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad. The name Jami carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ali was the fourth caliph of Islam and a prominent military and political leader.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jami remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
